lore_anchors.definition: The Grand Xia's ultimate defensive formation, centered on the Imperial Palace and amplified by 3,600 commandery cities. It can attack any point in the realm with power near that of a Daofather.
The supreme, primordial energy from which the universe was born, accessible only to beings who comprehend the Heavenly Dao of Chaos.
A condensed fruit of Chaos Force created by a True God or Daofather sacrificing a permanent portion of their own Chaos comprehension. It is a resource of immense strategic value.
A war formation of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, taking the form of a colossal, dragon-like beast.
A divine-spirit war machine formed by the Grand Xia's elite armies fusing their power, named after the ancient god Xingtian.
The most supreme of the Ten Heavenly Daos. To fully comprehend it is to become a Pangu-level creator god.
A legendary divine beast who achieved True God-hood and forged the Grand Xia World-Sealing Grand Formation.
A Pure Yang True Immortal and the primary commander of the Seamless Gate's invasion force for the Grand Xia world.
